I couldn't open the WIRED roundup, so this is based on the Macworld review and the ESR deal page. I haven't compared these against a broader set of tested models.

**Best overall: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W Charging Stand ($129.99)**
- **Charging speeds:** The iPhone charges at up to 25W over Qi2.2. The Apple Watch module and the AirPods pad each charge at 5W.
- **Adjustability:** Macworld says no rival stands as tall or adjusts as much. The weighted hinge gives a 160° viewing angle.
- **In the box:** A 45W adapter with US, UK and EU plugs.
- **Drawback:** It weighs 399g, so it works better as a desk or nightstand stand than a travel charger.
- **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V), [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW), [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w), [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html) or [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Satechi-3-in-1-Qi2-Wireless-Charging-Station-25W-Fast-Magnetic-Charger-Foldable-Stand-iPhone-Apple-Watch-AirPods-45W-USB-C-Adapter-Included-Space-Bla/19875453032).

**Best value: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W (about $82 with a code)**
- **Price:** It lists at $99.99. Code PARTNER18 takes off $17.99, and it worked in ESR's cart on Oct 23 (it expires Dec 31). The store's checkout has the final say.
- **Features:** It has a magnetic 25W phone pad, an Apple Watch pad, an earbud pad, an active cooling fan and a 50W adapter.
- **Speed depends on your iPhone:**
  - 25W: iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus, on iOS 26.
  - 20W: iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro.
  - 15W: older iPhones.
- **Warranty and returns:** 12 months, or 24 with free registration. Returns are accepted for 30 days.
- **Where to buy:** [ESR CryoBoost via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through this link, at no extra cost to you.
- **Cheaper version:** ESR also sells a 15W model for $79.99.

**Which to pick**
- Choose the **Satechi** if you want the most adjustable stand, with viewing angles that suit a desk or nightstand.
- Choose the **ESR** if you want the lower price. It also has a cooling fan.
- Macworld also mentions the Kuxiu X40 Turbo ($79.99) and the ESR Foldable ($99.99). Both are lighter, at 148g, so they suit travel better, but they adjust less than the Satechi.

**Verdict:** Macworld's Simon Jary calls it an update to a wireless favorite. The stand is taller and more adjustable than rival foldable chargers, though smaller and lighter options exist. He says "none stand as tall or are as adjustable as this one."

**Price:** $129.99, the same as the 15W predecessor. Alternatives include the Kuxiu X40 Turbo ($79.99) and ESR Foldable ($99.99), which are smaller and lighter but less adjustable. Satechi also sells a 15W 2-in-1 model for $79.99 if you don't have an Apple Watch.

**Charging speeds:**
- iPhone: up to 25W via Qi2.2 (wireless charging can't go faster than this without a cable)
- AirPods pad: 5W
- Apple Watch module: 5W, which is fast-charging for the Watch
- Total draw at full load is about 35W. The included 45W power adapter covers this with room to spare.

**Pros:**
- Charges iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods
- 25W iPhone charging
- Apple Watch fast charging
- Adjustable charging pad with a weighted hinge for a 160-degree viewing angle
- Folds for travel
- Includes US, UK, and EU plugs and a 45W adapter

**Cons:**
- Larger and heavier than rivals (399g, versus 148g for the Kuxiu and ESR), so it's more of a desktop stand than a true travel charger
